newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks down at midday on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks down at midday on profit-taking.

text.p: Jakarta stocks edged down at midday on Tuesday due to profit-taking, mostly in big-capitalised stocks, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index fell 2.84 points, or 0.41 percent, to 696.89 points at the lunch break. Decliners led advancers by 59 to 53, with 57 issues remained unchanged.
"The fall had been expected after recent sharp gains. The index had risen too sharply in the past several days after the elections," one broker said.
